articleTitle: A Garbage Classification Method Based on Improved YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Networks, Communications and Information Technology (CNCIT)
abstract: With the development of national economy, people's daily garbage is increasing day by day. Relying on manpower to sort garbage is a heavy workload and low efficiency. In this paper, an automatic garbage classification system model based on computer vision is proposed to solve the above problems. Firstly, the YOLOv5 object detection algorithm is improved, and abandoning small object detection to obtain faster detection speed. Secondly, shortcut the complex network layer in the YOLOv5 algorithm framework to speed up the recognition speed while ensuring the recognition accuracy. Finally, the traditional loss function is used to improve the detection speed of large objects in raspberry pie. We collect various types of garbage data set, trains the model on the improved algorithm and tests it by embedding raspberry pie. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm framework has the characteristics of fast speed and high precision, which can complete the garbage classification at the source of garbage.

articleTitle: Deep Reinforcement Learning on Wind Power Optimization
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Networks, Communications and Information Technology (CNCIT)
abstract: Wind farm layout optimization is formulated as a deep reinforcement learning (DRL) problem by defining the state, action, reward variables in the setup. A policy gradient reinforcement learning algorithm, proximal policy optimization (PPO), is applied and a deep convolutional neural network is designed to process the high-dimensional state and generate policy (actions given states) and value estimations. The DRL is compared with traditional genetic algorithm (GA) and shows promising results in the wind turbine layout optimization.

articleTitle: A Wind Noise Detection and Suppression Method in Digital Hearing Aid
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Networks, Communications and Information Technology (CNCIT)
abstract: The presence of wind noise will bring bad experiences to hearing aid wearers, impairing the signal quality and intelligibility. In this paper, a novel frequency-domain algorithm is introduced to detect and suppress the wind noise in the hearing aid and improve the user's comfort. Our method takes advantage of the characteristic that the wind noise energy is mainly concentrated in the low-frequency band and the correlation of wind noise collected by two microphones is significantly weaker than that of speech. Firstly, the cross-correlation coefficients of two input signals at low frequencies are calculated and compared with the preset threshold to determine whether there is wind noise. Secondly, the mathematical expression of the de-noised signal is obtained by using the similarity and spatial correlation of the two near-field signals to suppress the wind noise. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm can effectively reduce the energy of wind noise, avoid speech distortion and improve speech intelligibility.

articleTitle: Tagging schemes can do more in Named Entity Recognition: Take Chinese as an example
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Networks, Communications and Information Technology (CNCIT)
abstract: Tagging schemes are essential for sequence labeling tasks like chunking, named entity recognition (NER), etc. However, they are often specified beforehand and receive much less attention in NER now. We conduct research on existing commonly used tagging schemes and form a unified framework to describe existing tagging schemes. Taking Chinese NER (CNER) as an example, we find that tagging schemes can do more in NER. Motivated by the observation that existing tagging schemes tag non-entity tokens with the same label ‘O’, we propose a BIO<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>ES tagging scheme to tag non-entity tokens surrounding entities with ‘O-’ and ‘O+’ labels, thus utilizing the boundary information of entities. We proposed a tagging scheme with stacked labels to recognize nested entities. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed BIO<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>ES tagging scheme can improve the performance without modifying the model. And the stacked labels can help recognize nested entities. The results show that we can carry out more targeted research on the sequence labeling task transferred from NER by adjusting the tagging scheme reasonably.

articleTitle: Research on the construction method of ship formation action system
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Networks, Communications and Information Technology (CNCIT)
abstract: The thesis introduces the construction method of ship formation action system. By establishing “task-resource” model and “efficiency-emergence” aggregation model, the action system of ship formation is established scientifically based on MATLAB simulation. The formation action system can improve the formation ability and make the auxiliary suggest more scientific and directive.

articleTitle: Evaluation and application of fresh food safety through storage environment system based on factor analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Networks, Communications and Information Technology (CNCIT)
abstract: With the gradual development of the fresh food market, food safety issues frequently appear, and the impact of the fresh storage environment on the safety of fresh food has become the focus of research. This paper discusses the possible impact of fresh food in the storage environment, and summarizes the main factors that cause fresh food safety problems. Through the sampling monitoring of fresh food, analyze a series of fresh food index data, use factor analysis to explore the environmental factors affecting fresh food in storage, improve the construction of storage environment system, and effectively prevent fresh food from A security issue occurred during storage.

articleTitle: Based on the improved YOLOv3 remote sensing target detection algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Networks, Communications and Information Technology (CNCIT)
abstract: At present, deep learning technology has achieved remarkable results in remote sensing target detection, but there are still great challenges to improve the detection accuracy for the complex and changeable background environment in remote sensing images. To solve the above problems, an improved YOLOv3 remote sensing image target detection algorithm is proposed. Firstly, K-means clustering algorithm is used to cluster the data set and cluster the anchors of complex remote sensing targets; Secondly, the loss function is optimized to solve the problem of uneven distribution of difficult and easy samples and improve the ability of the network to extract target features in complex scenes. Finally, the RFB module is introduced to expand the receptive field of the network and strive to improve the missed detection of small targets and dense targets.

articleTitle: Government Subsidies, Shareholder Structure and the Performance of Listed Military Enterprises under Digital
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Networks, Communications and Information Technology (CNCIT)
abstract: Digitalization promotes the development of listed military enterprises. It is imperative that the long-term development of listed military enterprises be supported with funding. Government subsidies and private capital, as an important source of funds for listed military enterprises, have a profound impact on the development of the company. Thus, this paper makes some empirical studies in the effect of government subsidies and shareholder structure on the performance of listed military enterprises, based on a sample of listed military enterprises in A-share markets during the period 2016 − 2020. The results show that government subsidies have a significantly positive effect on the performance of listed military enterprises. Shareholder structure has a moderating effect on government subsidies.

articleTitle: On the Security of a Verifiable Data Aggregation Scheme for Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Networks, Communications and Information Technology (CNCIT)
abstract: Liu et al. proposed a verifiable data aggregation scheme for Internet of Things based on a certificateless aggregate signature algorithm. (DOI: 10.1109/ICC.2017.7996720, 2017 IEEE International Conference on Communications). Under the random oracle model, Liu et al.'s scheme was proved that there is unforgeability under the adaptive chosen message attack. However, we analyze the security of Liu et al.'s scheme and show that it cannot resist type of II attacks, coalition attacks and forge attacks without any secret authorization. To overcome the above security flaws, we propose a new certificateless aggregate signature scheme based on Liu et al.'s scheme. According to the security and performance analysis, the enhanced scheme improves the security and maintains the performance of the original scheme.

articleTitle: High Performance Plasma Antenna for Wireless Communication Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Networks, Communications and Information Technology (CNCIT)
abstract: This paper investigates the effect of the size of the outer ring/cylinder of the cylindrical coupling system on the performance of the tubular plasma antenna. The coupling system consists of two rings/cylinders and is needed to couple the RF signal generated by a source to the plasma antenna for radiation. The performance of the plasma antenna with different outer ring dimensions has been investigated in terms of different antenna characteristics such as reflection coefficients, input impedance, total efficiency, and realized gain. Simulation analysis shows that varying the radius of the outer cylinder of the coupling system largely affect the impedance matching where improper size can lead to very poor antenna performance while proper sizes can enhance the performance to reach > 90% total efficiency.

articleTitle: Research and Analysis of AGV State Model Based on Network Topology Directed Graph
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Networks, Communications and Information Technology (CNCIT)
abstract: At present, AGV has been widely used in the production workshop of tobacco enterprises. In the actual operation process, AGV will have the problem of collision. Therefore, this paper proposes a method based on the directed graph of network topology, establishes the state model of AGV walking, and proposes an anti-collision search method based on this model. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is proved by simulation.

Author Keywords: AGV loop deadlock network topology state model

articleTitle: Research on Application Strategy of Confidentiality and Integrity Protection Algorithm on 5G Air Interface
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Networks, Communications and Information Technology (CNCIT)
abstract: In the evolution of mobile communications from 4G to 5G, the concept of security design and protection has been proposed. The wireless air interface may face risks, such as identity spoofing, service denial and replay attacks. It is crucial to protect the confidentiality and integrity of data. In this article, we analyze the performances for three kinds of confidentiality and integrity protection algorithms for 5G air interface, and put forward application strategies in different scenarios. It is beneficial to popularize various kinds of cryptographic algorithms and make the mechanism of the protection algorithms in the customized network perfect.

articleTitle: Cloud-Edge Collaborative Computation Offloading: A Deep Reinforcement Learning approach
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Networks, Communications and Information Technology (CNCIT)
abstract: Aiming at the optimization problem of computation offloading for multiple indicators in the cloud-edge collaborative environment, a cloud-edge collaborative computation offloading optimization algorithm based on deep Q-learning network (DQN) is proposed. Firstly, the cloud-edge collaborative computation offloading optimization problem is modeled as a Markov Decision Process (MDP); secondly, three key indicators of the average delay, average energy consumption, and server provider's revenue per unit time of computation offloading are jointly optimized; thirdly, DQN algorithm is used to solve it. The simulation results show that with the increase in the number of computation offloading tasks, the method in this paper achieves the optimal comprehensively on the above three key indicators compared with the other baselines.

articleTitle: Experimental Implementation of Remote Attestation over OPC UA Protocol
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Networks, Communications and Information Technology (CNCIT)
abstract: We present design alternatives and a proof-of-concept demonstration realising the inclusion of remote attestation into Open Platform Communication - Unified Architecture (OPC UA), a modern Operational Technology (OT) protocol. This aspect is not yet covered by the OPC UA set of specifications. Remote attestation is about ascertaining the integrity of the software and the configuration of the attested devices, and is considered to be essential for safeguarding critical infrastructure. Remote attestation and OPC UA concepts are briefly summarized. We discuss alternatives for realising remote attestation over OPC UA, and, based on their relative merits, select one for experimentation. Related work is also discussed. Python-based proof-of-concept implementation was realised and experimented with for unearthing relevant issues that need to be resolved for actual OPC UA remote attestation. The findings are presented and the demonstrator is available as open source software as an example how to implement remote attestation over OPC UA protocol.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Dependent Task Offloading Strategy in Mobile Edge Computing
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Networks, Communications and Information Technology (CNCIT)
abstract: The emerging MEC computing paradigm can effectively relieve the computational pressure on mobile devices by offloading computationally intensive tasks to edge servers, which in turn reduces energy consumption and extends device lifetime. However, due to the large decision space, nonlinear dependent tasks with complex subtask topology can only be considered as a whole for coarse-grained offloading decisions. In order to minimize the device energy consumption, in this paper we propose an algorithm named Edge Computing Offloading with All Topo Sorting by fully considering the topology of nonlinear dependent tasks. First, we can transform the nonlinear topology of a local application into a set of linear topologies by all topology sorting algorithm. Then for tasks with linear topologies, the local computation frequency, transmission power and computation offloading decisions of the mobile device are optimized to minimize its task execution energy consumption. Simulation results show that the proposed algorithm for nonlinear dependent tasks can effectively save energy consumption with low time complexity.

articleTitle: Application and Practice of MVC Architecture Pattern in On-the-job Internship Management System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Networks, Communications and Information Technology (CNCIT)
abstract: In View of the characteristics of the management of on-the-job internship in vocational education, such as scattered internship sites, inconsistent working hours etc., are difficult to manage. A management system of on-the-job internship based on MVC architecture pattern was constructed. First, the working principle and technical advantages of MVC architecture pattern are analyzed. Second, the functional requirements of the system are sorted out, and the framework structure of the system is designed based on the MVC architecture pattern. Third, the basic business logic of View, Control and Model are designed based on MVC architecture pattern and SpringMVC development framework. In order to better carry out the decoupling of system functions, besides the three-tier of MVC architecture pattern, another data access object is extracted to separate the system business logic and data storage. Finally, based on the above design architecture, JSP, Java language and other technologies are used to implement the system. The experimental results show that this system has obvious effect on improving the efficiency of internship management and further improving the quality of internship teaching.

articleTitle: Radar-Based Heart Sound Monitoring using Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Networks, Communications and Information Technology (CNCIT)
abstract: Continuous heart sound monitoring is proven to provide valuable clinical information to the diagnosis and treatment of cardiovascular conditions. This article explores the potential of heart sound monitoring using radar, a convenient and accessible method to provide continuous data acquired through non-invasive and touch-free means. Specifically, we designed and trained convolutional neural networks to recognize first and second heart sounds (S1 and S2) from collected radar signals. The proposed algorithm has achieved considerably high correlations to the reference S1 and S2 locations, and its overall performance was comparable to conventional phonocardiogram-based heart sound monitoring approach.

articleTitle: A Study of Hearing Aid Fitting Formulas Based on Polynomial Approximation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Networks, Communications and Information Technology (CNCIT)
abstract: Wearing hearing aids is one of the effective measures to correct the hearing condition of patients with hearing loss. The choice of the prescription formula is the key to hearing aid gain compensation. DSL-v5 is a commonly used fitting prescription formula, which is designed mainly for pediatric patients. It introduces the Real-Ear-to-Coupler Difference (RECD) test, taking into account the patient's age and hearing threshold, adding an understanding of hearing test methods, hearing aid types, microphone position effects, and hearing assessment with plug-in headphones. To aggregate various factors, this paper proposes a DSL-v5 fitting formula through a least squares-based polynomial fitting method, and verifies the accuracy of this fitting formula by testing experiments. The experiments demonstrate that the fitting formula can well meet the gain compensation needs of adult patients and pediatric patients.

articleTitle: Fast Continuous Scalar Multiplication Algorithms on Twisted Edwards Elliptic Curve
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Networks, Communications and Information Technology (CNCIT)
abstract: In this paper, we research the operation rules and scalar multiplication of Twisted Edwards elliptic curve. Based on the properties of point addition and double point operations, we propose the fast continuous double point algorithm, continuous point addition algorithm and continuous double point-point addition algorithm on Twisted Edwards elliptic curve. These algorithms reduce the amount of operations significantly by reducing the inverse operations. For comparison purposes, the top-level operations of the new algorithm use the non-adjacent form(NAF) and double base number system(DBNS) scalar multiplication algorithms. In contrast, it effectively improves the computational efficiency of the Twisted Edwards elliptic curve scalar multiplication algorithm, in which it is more than 50% faster than the underlying operation using Horner's rule, continuous multiplier algorithm, and about 10% to 35% or more faster than the base operation using the 4-NNAF algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on threat modeling for 5G network data analytics function
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Networks, Communications and Information Technology (CNCIT)
abstract: Network Data Analytics Function (NWDAF) promotes the rapid development of artificial intelligence and big data technology in the field of 5G communication. In order to analyze the security challenges faced by NWDAF in the open 5G network operating environment, a threat modeling method for NWDAF was proposed in combination with the STRIDE framework. Several mature threat modeling methods and ideas in the industry were firstly introduced; then the attack surface was analysed and a data flow diagram was created for NWDAF, the STRIDE method and the OWASP risk rating idea were used for threat identification and threat rating; finally, the targeted threat mitigation measures and protective means were formulated.

articleTitle: Misbehavior Detection based on Deep Learning for VANETs
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Networks, Communications and Information Technology (CNCIT)
abstract: With the development of intelligent driving technology, the reliability of inter-vehicle communication has been put on the agenda. The safety and efficiency of vehicular communication depend on the correctness of data exchange among vehicles. As the Internet of Things (IoT) is increasingly used in Vehicular Ad Hoc Networks (VANETs), the number of connected vehicles will grow exponentially in the coming years, meaning the number of communication interfaces will increase and so there will be the potential for cyber security attacks. Therefore, it is necessary to add anomaly detection schemes to the existing security schemes to distinguish normal vehicle data from malicious and erroneous data. We use the VeReMi data set to detect the abnormal behavior of common location errors on roads and classify the types of location anomalies. The deep learning neural network model and LSTM model, on the basis of traditional machine learning, can make us once find improper behavior of communication and is possible to categorize it. We can use more accurate and specific steps to deal with these unusual projects to improve the safety of the vehicle system and the ability to quickly recover from the abnormal behavior.

articleTitle: Improved quantum attack on several generalized unbalanced Feistel structures
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Networks, Communications and Information Technology (CNCIT)
abstract: By studying the attack technology based on Simon, Grover and other quantum algorithms for the security of block cipher structure, this paper proposes new quantum attack on 6 generalized unbalanced Feistel structures. We improve the attack results of n-cell structure, New Structure I/III/IV structure and FBC-like structure, and give a quantum attack on Skipjack structure for the first time. Based on Simon algorithm, this paper constructs a n<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>-round, a 12/12/6-round and a 4-round quantum distinguisher about n-cell structure, New structure I/III/IV and FBC-like structure, improving n<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>-n-1 rounds, 6 rounds/3 rounds/1 round and 1 round separately, comparing to the previous results. In addition, this paper also constructs a 9-round quantum distinguisher about Skipjack structure. Moreover, this paper proposes a quantum key recovery attack on the above six structures in combination with Grover algorithm, and the time complexities of attacks are analyzed.

articleTitle: Deep Reinforcement Learning-Based Pricing Strategy in Double-Auction Market for Edge Computing Resource Allocation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Networks, Communications and Information Technology (CNCIT)
abstract: Due to the rapid increase in Internet of Things (IoT) terminals, the continuous double auction (CDA) has been applied to achieve the reasonable allocation of edge server resources. Existing research focuses on the matching mechanism of the auction and the convergence of the game with implementation of the same strategy, while neglecting exploration of the advantageous pricing strategy for agents when multiple strategies are applied simultaneously. In this paper, we establish a CDA market where IoT terminals act as buyers, edge servers act as sellers, and cloud servers perform the market clearing work. All agents in the market pursue maximization of their own revenues by competing against others. Zero intelligence (ZI), experience-weighted attraction (EWA), deep Q-learning (DQN), and deep deterministic policy gradient (DDPG) are deployed for both buyers and sellers to enable bidding and asking. Historical trading information of the market is used as a substitute for real-time global information, which is inaccessible. The cases of unpredictable requests and fixed requests are discussed separately. Experimental results demonstrate that the game converges to equilibrium with the two environments and the deep reinforcement learning-based strategies outperform the classical algorithms. In particular, the DDPG-based strategy obtains a superior response faster than does the DQN-based strategy.

articleTitle: Efficient Authorized Keyword Search Supporting Boolean Formula Over Encrypted Data in Cloud Storage System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Networks, Communications and Information Technology (CNCIT)
abstract: Recently, personal health record system is a promising patient-centered model for exchange and management of information. Although this cloud-based system brings in much convenience for the management and sharing, the assumption that these service providers can be fully trusted in handling patients' sensitive information seems to be undesirable. To ensure patients' fine-grained access control over privacy, data encryption (e.g., Attribute-based Encryption) is considered to be a emerging solution. However, an important functionality keyword search becomes especially challenging with records stored in encrypted form. In order to achieve access control and keyword search simultaneously, the concept of authorized keyword search was introduced to allow only authorized users can search and further access the encrypted data. However, most existing authorized keyword search schemes only support conjunctive keyword search, while other expressive keyword search schemes constructed over composite order groups are computationally inefficient. In this paper, we present the first efficient and expressive authorized keyword search scheme from bilinear pairings over the prime order groups, which enables any monotonic Boolean formulas to represent access strategies and keyword search strategies. Then, we define its formal security, and prove its selective security in the standard model. Finally, performance evaluation shows its effectiveness.

articleTitle: SolChecker: A Practical Static Analysis Framework for Ethereum Smart Contract
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Networks, Communications and Information Technology (CNCIT)
abstract: Ethereum, a blockchain-based platform, provides a suitable environment for coding and executing smart contracts among trustless parties. However, smart contracts are exposed to inherent security risks due to manipulating digital units of value on a public decentralized blockchain. Even worse, vulnerabilities can hardly be fixed as the contracts are stored on the blockchain. Hence, there is a significant need to write secure and well-performing contracts and ensure their high reliability. To overcome these challenges, we propose an automated static framework SolChecker, for vulnerability detection on Solidity smart contracts. It works by analyzing information extracted from constructed abstract syntax tree of Solidity smart contracts, and developers can use the analyzed results to design detectors for specific vulnerabilities according to their needs. In this paper, we present an overview of SolChecker, provide the detailed design of each component, and evaluate the capabilities of the designed detectors on 47,037 real-world contracts. Furthermore, we clarify the effect of each extracted information by performing a comparative experiment on 500 contracts sampled from the dataset. Our tool reflects the current state of knowledge on Solidity vulnerabilities.

articleTitle: A mulberry detection method in the complex background based on improved D-YOLOv3
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Networks, Communications and Information Technology (CNCIT)
abstract: Currently, mulberry has important crop value. In the densely planted field, many mulberry trees would be overlapped and occluded to varying degrees. To solve the mulberry tree identification problem based on overlapping and occlusion environment, the improved YOLOv3 model was proposed in this study. The improved method uses DensNet's dense connection mechanism to replace the last three sub-sampling layers of feature extraction network DarkNet53 in the YOLOv3 network to reuse features and retain important semantic features. Secondly, use the CloU loss instead of the IoU loss in YOLOv3 to improve the speed of target recognition and achieve better detection performance. And the K-means clustering is used to set the parameters of the mulberry target anchor box, which improves the accuracy of complex target recognition and location. Moreover, a transfer learning strategy was adopted to help train new models, which can greatly enhance the generalization ability of the model. The experiment tests the improved and original methods' detection performance. And the influence of different training methods on the model, respectively. The results showed that the proposed model could effetely detect mulberry trees based on overlapping and occlusion environment. It is of great significance to provide the theoretical vision basis for intelligent mulberry leaf picking in the future.

articleTitle: Towards a Dynamic Network Architecture
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Networks, Communications and Information Technology (CNCIT)
abstract: With the diversification of network requirements, it is difficult for traditional network architectures to adapt to the current network environment. To deal with this problem, we present nForest, a distributed and flexible networking architecture with microservice. nForest flexible assembly service to match network requirements, and realizes communication among the microservice by a distributed message bus. Repairer & Strangler Pattern achieves smoothly transition from the existing architecture. At the same time, it was verified that nForest achieved better architecture flexibility by sacrificing a shorter response time between microservices in the communication simulation experiment.

articleTitle: Developing the Factory of the Future Cybersecurity and Resilience
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Networks, Communications and Information Technology (CNCIT)
abstract: In this article, we have studied methods to improve the cybersecurity and resilience of Industry 4.0 and so-called factories of the future (FoF). In particular, we have focused on the technical aspects of protecting factories against cyber-attacks. More precisely, we review what factory assets need to be protected, how to detect anomalies that may indicate an ongoing cyberattack, how to mitigate cyberattacks against those assets, and how to initiate suitable countermeasures. Furthermore, we study how to recover factory assets after a cyberattack. We describe how software-defined networking, machine learning, and neural networks can be used to monitor factory assets, manage identities and control access to factory assets, detect adversarial attacks against artificial intelligence-embedded assets, and support resilient operations of future factories. These findings provide useful insights into design and operation of secure and resilient factories of the future.

articleTitle: FL-DPA: A Data Plane Abstraction Enabling Open-Source TSN Chip Design
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Networks, Communications and Information Technology (CNCIT)
abstract: In most distributed hard real-time scenarios, customizing a Time-Sensitive Networking (TSN) chip is critical for meeting their differentiated requirements. The open-source TSN chip aims to provide a primary reference for scenario-driven TSN chip customization. However, the design of an opensource TSN chip faces three challenges. (1) how to provide a set of basic functions for guiding the customization of the TSN chip. (2) how to provide a theoretical analysis method for evaluating the deterministic end-to-end delay and jitter. (3) how to precisely describe the data plane for enabling the development of a well-adapted control plane. To solve the above challenges, we propose FL-DPA, a data plane abstraction for the open-source TSN chip. FL-DPA consists of tables, parameters, buffers and queues. The tables in FL-DPA reflect a set of functions that satisfy the basic requirements of different TSN scenarios. The deterministic forwarding model abstracted from FL-DPA supports the theoretical analysis of end-to-end delay and jitter. Moreover, FL-DPA enables the development of a well-adapted control plane with an accurate description. The implementation details of the data plane are transparent to the control plane. To demonstrate the benefits of FL-DPA, we design an open-source TSN chip named Fenglin and build a testbed based on FPGA arrays. The experimental results show that the Fenglin chip supports mixed-critical traffic and delivers a microsecond-level determinism service.

articleTitle: Prevention Detection for Cyclists based on Faster R-CNN
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Networks, Communications and Information Technology (CNCIT)
abstract: Cycling is becoming increasingly common on the roads, and the growth of this activity raises safety concerns. Bicycles are becoming one of the most common ways of transportation worldwide. Almost every day, though, there is an incident in which a driver hits and kills a rider. In the past few years, the number of avoidable deaths from bicycle transportation events has climbed by 37%. (National Safety Council). Thus, prediction prevention is an essential task in order to avoid such incidents. This article provides a summary of recent developments in commercial devices for cyclists as well as intent estimation to improve rider safety. Understanding the intentions of vehicles enables cyclists to take precautionary measures to prevent collisions. To accomplish this, the development of methods/ techniques for the autonomous vehicle, such as machine learning (ML), will be investigated. For example, employing DL techniques like R-CNN, and Faster R-CNN, the development of pedestrian detection has improved dramatically. While machine learning techniques have been around for decades, the technology required to implement them has just recently been made available. However, using a different approach by employing these ML approaches for vehicle detection and applying it for prediction estimations can allow for an effective and accurate way of vehicle intent estimation. A standard generic object identification framework is used to recognize the vehicle and assess the speed and distance from the cyclist. Then warn the rider ahead of time if it is speeding up or slowing down, calculating if it can slow down at that pace. To tackle the given challenge, we employed a two-stage Faster R-CNN detector.
